description: D-104: grants the embedded WebDriver server's permission, only relevant when the binary is built with the `e2e-testing` Cargo feature (see Cargo.toml) — that's the only configuration where `tauri-plugin-wdio-webdriver`'s permission schema even exists. Not listed in tauri.conf.json's default `security.capabilities`, so this file is inert for every ordinary build; the E2E config in docs/notes/e2e-testing.md adds "e2e" to that list only for the test build.
